blocks.text:
MULTIPLE USE: With 5 Tiers storage shelves, this ladder bookshelf can be used to store books, CDs, or display various decorations according to your preference. Not only just a book shelf, but also a perfect art decoration for your living room and office.
 ADJUSTABLE SHELVES: Considering the size of different items, the display shelves are designed to be adjustable, so you can adjust the bookcase shelf according to the size of the items you want to play.
 STABLE AND DURABLE: Crafted from steel frame and particle board, this wide bookshelf has high stability and long service life, each shelf can hold up to 50 lbs.The bookshelves come with anti-tilt brackets so you can fasten them to the wall for support.
 ADJUSTABLE FEET: 4 plastic feet under the legs can be adjusted to accommodate the uneven floor and protect your floor from damage during movement.
 EASY TO ASSEMBLE: Product size: 67.5 x 11.8 x 23.6 inches. Package includes all installation tools and clear instruction manual, each component is labeled with a number, the book case is easy to put together within 30 minute.

items: Shintenchi Arched Book Shelf Takes Up Small Spaces But Providing Generous Storage Space for Your Office, Living Room, Study and Balcony, Less Cumbersome Than Traditional Large Bookshelf.

items.label: Modern Arched Design
items.value: The elegant curved design on metal top adds a refined touch to the entire bookshelf.With its clean lines and wood grain texture, this industrial-style bookcase complements any space.

items.label: Multifunctional Bookcase
items.value: Shintenchi 5 shelf bookshelf provides a very wide storage space, you can use it to place all kinds of items as you see fit. Books, photo albums, crafts, potted plants and etc. Beautiful bookshelf panel with waterproof and anti-scratch features, very easy to clean.

items.label: High-Quality Metal Frame Bookcase
items.value: Constructed by premium metal and selected particle board, the contemporary metal bookcase is solid, stable, sturdy, and durable. With top notch anti-rust coating, the whole shelf looks more sophisticated. With an excellent metal frame and thick solid panel, each panel of the bookcase can hold up to 50 lbs. Because of the fixed rod assembly, the industrial shelf has strong stability and can perfectly protect your items. No shaking No wobbling.

items.label: Easy Assembly & Easy to Clean
items.value: The corner bookshelf comes with step-by-step illustrated instructions and necessary accessories to help you finish the whole installation effortlessly, the hardware and parts are marked with numbers or letters on each piece for your needs.
